publishedNames: Dr. Jai Prakash Navendu Maharshi Avtar
person.biography: Dr. Jai Prakash Navendu Maharshi Avtar is a Hindi Dalit poet, writer and thinker whose works explore caste discrimination, social justice, equality, politics, religion and human values. Through poetry, stories, novels and philosophical writing, he advocates for social reform and a more inclusive society.

education.note: The biography says he lived with his sister's family while studying.

doctoralResearch.topic: A comparative psychological study of the story literature of Ajay and Jainendra Jain
doctoralResearch.note: The biography says the PhD was left incomplete in 1987 after a disagreement with a later supervisor related to caste.

career.additionalNote: The biography says he chose to leave the principal post because he feared it would hinder his creative work.
